title: Wii - Working Pages
description:
[h1]Wii Menu Wallpaper - Working Pages[/h1]

[h2]Info / Credit[/h2]
This mod builds upon the mod published by Lilykyu 
The original mod is available here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3526096300
If you have set up the script for this it will work, however it does support app shortcuts, so you dont need any external dependancies to make this workl!

[h2]Setup[/h2]
To add new apps you can go to the Channel Images section, select an image, gif or video for the channel and then set the shortcut to whatever you want it to open.
For script users, the new channels are app13+, add these the same way that apps 1 to 12 are done
New buttons at the bottom:
[list]
	[*]Wii button: app013
	[*]SD card: app014
	[*]Mail button: app015
	[*]Music Player: app017
[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
	[*]Corrected sounds (some sounds did not match to Wii menu, these have been corrected, I can't promise they are all correct though)
	[*]Updated Wii channel frames
	[*]Functional menu bar buttons (available as apps 013, 014 and 015 respectively)
	[*]Pages, This has 4 pages, 12 apps per page the same as the original Wii, however this can be increased up to 10, or reduced
	[*]Multi monitor support (Monitor 2's apps would be 49 to 96, this looks at reduced pages, so if you only have 2 pages Monior 2's apps would be 25 onwards). This is for script users specifically.
	[*]Dark Mode
	[*]Full Accent colouring (including background)
	[*]Auto theming music player
	[*]Music theming
	[*]Custom icons
	[*]Clock customization
	[*]Multi language support 
	[*]Volume controls 
	[*]Media player integration! The Music channel is app017 if you want to make it launch an app when you click it.
	[*]Pre built themes
	[*]Full per element theming (see Advanced Theme)
	[*]Effect when you leave a channel
	[*]Change log that displays whenever the wallpaper updates in the app
	[*]Launch apps using Wallpaper engines build in app shortcut feature!
	[*]Optional double click to launch apps
	[*]Optional disc popout
	[*]Custom backgrounds 
	[*]Full custom opacity
	[*]Channel tags when you hover over channels
	[*]Optional double click to launch apps
	[*]Pause videos when not hovered (along with other options)
	[*]Edge channel can be set to not trigger like on the original Wii menu
	[*]Effects, leaves, snow, rainfall and more
	[*]No doubt more things I've forgotten to add in here

[/list]

[h2]Thanks[/h2]
[list]
	[*]TropicalPunchy - provided the app frame mask
	[*]Mango - App Frames
	[*]UnraveledCape24 - Language translations, and provided some icons
	[*]Bug testers - Anyone who's helped me test for / told me about any bugs, its so so helpful!
	[*]Lilykyu - Providing the idea and the basis for the wallpaper
[/list]

[h2]Bugs[/h2]

[h3]Reporting Bugs[/h3]
Please when reporting a bug try to provide the following info (version is mandatory):
[list]
	[*]Version (available at the top of wallpaper settings along with all the other options such as dark mode)
	[*]What is the error
	[*]What is the expected result
	[*]What where you doing when the bug occurred (not always relevant)
[/list]

These details help me find and resolve issues faster, as well as letting me be sure the issues isn't just caused by Wallpaper engine not having updated the wallpaper for you. You are also welcome to request features, and usually I will do my best to add them. Do note this may take time as I both have a full time job and life, and have a few features I am working on currently.

[h3]Known Bugs / Issues[/h3]
[list]
	[*]Poor support for ultrawides
	[*]Crash when changing to high performance (reached out to WP engine dev team)
[/list]

[h2]The Big TODO List[/h2]
[list]
	[*]Wii cursor built in
	[*]Ultrawide support
	[*]Code cleanup (and a few fixes regarding animations that dont properly scale with FPS) <In Progress>
	[*]New logic for selecting music themed colours
[/list]

title: FNaF 4 Main Menu (Rain / Ambience)
description:
The Five Nights at Freddy's 4 Title screen as a completely customizable wallpaper! You can adjust the volume of the rain and background music separately. All visual effects can be toggled individually, so you can turn off the leaves and rain and stuff if you don't like it. There's also an optional VHS filter and snow if you want.


I wanted a large list of background music from all throughout the series. I did my best to pick quieter, unintrusive and atmospheric songs because I don't like loud wallpapers

🎵 Background Music tracks include:

  - Title screen tracks from FNaF 1, 2, and 4
  - FNaF 3 Good Ending song "Don't Go" and Happiest Day song "Close to Stop"
  - FNaF 4 bedroom and plushtrap ambiance
  - FNAF World Dusting Fields music and Halloween theme "Don't Open the Door"
  - Sister Location custom night tracks and "Demolition Inevitable"
  - Pizza Sim Credits theme "Necessary Evil"
  - ALL of the BGM from UCN
  - Curse of Dreadbear hub music
  - Overworld map tracks from FNaF AR
  - "Through the Cracks" from Freddy in Space 2
  - Princess Quest theme "Caught in a Loop" as well as "Hunted" from Security Breach
  - "Your Special Day" and Credits from RUIN
  - Princess Quest IV theme "Gracefully Into the Abyss" and "Phantogeusia" from Help Wanted 2
  - "X43" and "Good Ending" from Into The Pit
  - "Breathing Corridors" from Secret of the Mimic
  -  A few tracks from the FNaF Movies; "Clean Up", "Delinquent Notice", "Mike's Dream Sequence I", "Vanessa", and some of "A Boat Ride" from FNaF 2
- "Remnants of Joy" mashup from TJOC


(I have it set to randomly play them so sorry if you get the same song played several times in a short period)

I plan on updating this wallpaper with more music as new games come out, to incorporate as much of the series as possible :)
